raw_value_policy: x_value/y_value and *_raw columns retain the reconstructed original axis values and units. Standardized columns are populated only when digitization_overrides.json explicitly requests a target unit and the deterministic dimensional factor table supports the exact conversion. The original columns are never overwritten.
standardization_policy: Per-axis x_target_unit/y_target_unit requests are opt-in. Each axis reports its own status. Unsupported or missing-unit conversions remain unresolved. Electrode-reference scale conversions are separate and are never performed by dimensional unit factors.
subject_condition_policy: Every point row carries its series-level subject links and measurement conditions as JSON; series_metadata.jsonl remains a companion audit record.
compatibility_policy: No automatic merging or conversion across unresolved reference scales, units, capacity bases, cell scopes, analyte metrics, or experimental conditions. Rows carry compatibility_status=NOT_HARMONIZED until a separate validated harmonization stage is implemented.
qc_policy: Only REVIEWED_ACCEPTED records are included when include_review_required=false. Unreviewed rows remain explicitly flagged otherwise.
